description: A close reading of the two-part Heroes: Bregman’s documentary, Daniel’s tape, Fraiser’s death, the eulogy, oversight and the ethics of filming and withholding.

related_resources.reason: February 13, 2004 air date, Cooper/Mikita credits; Bregman and SG-13; presidential documentary commission and production testimony.
February 20, 2004 air date, credits, death of Janet Fraiser, and attributed recollections of the contested decision.
Daniel’s recording of Wells, Fraiser’s final rescue, Daniel’s and Bregman’s discussion, memorial and Carter’s eulogy.
Cooper retrospective about how the proposed documentary episode changed and became a two-parter.
Robert C. Cooper’s firsthand comments on the three-month production of Heroes and its significance.
